response.query: What swab types and elution protocols maximize GBS recovery and reproducibility (swab material, elution volume, vortex/pressure, recovery % targets)?

results.title: What is the meaning of ''what''? - Quora
results.content: "What" is a pronoun used to introduce a question or to refer to a thing or things that are not specifically identified. It is often used to request information

results.title: WHAT definition in American English - Collins Dictionary
results.content: 1. question word You use what in questions when you ask for specific information about something that you do not know.

results.title: Why do Americans use the word "What" instead of "How ... - Reddit
